wine_prefix.description: The directory where Wine stores its data, including the registry and configuration files.

wine_arch.description: The Windows architecture to support. Can be 'win32' or 'win64'. Set at prefix creation time.

wine_dll_overrides.description: DLL load order overrides. Format: dll=type,type. Types: 'n' (native), 'b' (builtin), '' (disabled).

wine_path.description: Additional Windows-style paths to prepend to the PATH environment variable, separated by ';'.

wine_d3d_config.description: Direct3D configuration options as comma/semicolon-separated key-value pairs.

display.description: The X11 display server to use for graphical output.

audio_dev.description: The audio device file for input/output.

mixer_dev.description: The mixer device file for controlling audio levels.
